content:
leo: Heads up — small but visible invoice_preview delta tied to route metadata truncation between 01:10-01:25 UTC. Looks like X-Route-Meta is getting cut and enricher falls back to default route.
anika: Where's truncation happening? edge LB or proxy pool?
derek: Proxy LBs with default header frame size 4096; we pushed richer JSON for route metadata last month so some headers now exceed the frame. Truncated headers -> fallback routing tag.
viv: That makes the requests pick the 'fallback' sku which is pricier. Which tenants impacted?
leo: 6 large tenants, ~0.5% request volume in the window, per-tenant previews show +2-12% token delta.
metrics-bot: alert: route_meta_truncate_rate > 0.2% in prod-eu (last 30m)
anika: Immediate low-risk mitigation options?
derek: Two paths: 1) bump LB header_max_size and restart (invasive), or 2) make enricher tolerant: detect truncation and try to rehydrate metadata from body or secondary header.
viv: Prefer option 2 for now. Add a metric for truncated_header_count and a reconciliation job.
leo: Agreed. Also freeze invoice finalization for the affected window until we reconcile.
derek: I'll open a PR for tolerant parsing + metrics + canary on 5% of enrichers (CHG-10234). Pseudocode in PR description.
anika: Add unit tests for partial JSON fragments and ensure best-effort fallback won't misroute legitimate minimal headers.
derek: will do. Reconciliation: recompute enrichment with tolerant parser for 01:00-02:00 and write s3://billing-audit/route-trunc-7070001111/deltas.csv
viv: Billing will ingest that CSV and mark previews for manual review. We'll also notify affected tenants once audit complete.
metrics-bot: canary deploy started for enricher tolerant-parse (CHG-10234) at 7070001200
derek: Canary telemetry: truncated_header_count caught 0->12 on canary nodes but route_recovery_success ~93%.
leo: Good. After 15m stable roll to 50% then 100%.
deploy-bot: CHG-10234 canary complete at 7070001400. Progressive rollout scheduled.
